text:
Maya Li: Kiosk checklist for DevTown mini booth (Fri). Quick run-through: swag counts, slides, lead QR, and demo routing. Keeping this short.
Owen Clark: Swag status: vendor confirmed stickers + tees. Shipping says arrive Fri 9am local. Tracking: UPS 1ZABC.
Rory James: Tee sizes please. Last event we had too many Ls.
Maya Li: Sizes pulled from last run: 45% M, 35% L, 12% S, 8% XL. Ordering 30% extra S this time.
Priya Shah: I'll order 15 S, 10 XL extra. ETA confirmed?
Logistics Ops: ETA Fri 9am. If delayed we can courier from city shop for $95.
Owen Clark: Good. I'll approve courier if needed. Also need final postcard proof for bench narrative.
Maya Li: Draft copy for postcard back: "Redwood Inference: predictable LLM inference for production. Avg latency 85ms; 30% cost reduction vs baseline. Scan to see live demos." Front: bench viz.
Rory James: Can we make bench numbers 3 bullets: latency, cost, and throughput? Keep bullets short.
Maya Li: Yep. Marketing wants a 10-word hook for the social post. Suggestions?
Priya Shah: "Ship LLM features, not infrastructure. Fast, cheap, reliable inference"
Owen Clark: Nice. Use that verbatim for the LinkedIn copy.
Maya Li: OK. QR plan 1: two QR types printed on postcards and demo badges. Mapping below:
```
qr.redwood.com/devtown -> choose page
if path=/signup?src=devtown&flow=hosted -> quick signup -> auto credits
if path=/capture?src=devtown&flow=dedicated -> capture lead + ask "deploy timeline" -> route to AE queue `devtown-dedicated`
append ?variant=postcard or ?variant=badge depending on scancode
```
EventBot: Reminder set: create webhook `events/devtown/lead` and tag `devtown-postcard`.
Priya Shah: Important: capture `event_variant` and `scanned_asset` fields to CRM. Also capture explicit opt-in.
Rory James: For A/B follow-up we want to know bench vs demo interest. Include hidden param `interest=bench|demo`.
Maya Li: We'll embed `interest=bench` on bench postcards and `interest=demo` on demo-only stickers.
Owen Clark: Staffing: Need two demoers during peak (11:30-1:30), one for lead intake, one floater. Can we get an SDR?
Priya Shah: Hannah from SDRs is available 11-2. I'll book her.
Maya Li: Slide deadline: panels & demos need slides by Thursday midnight. Please upload to `drive/redwood/events/devtown/slides` and name `lastname_devtown_v1.pdf`.
Rory James: Also add 2 benchmark callouts on slide 2 for marketing social cards.
Owen Clark: Webinar tie-in: collect emails for a post-event webinar on "Inference economics". Add checkbox copy: "Yes, sign me up for a short webinar about inference tips." Default unchecked.
Maya Li: Good call. We'll add a post-event nurture with 3 emails. Owen, can you draft the webinar blurb?
Owen Clark: Will do by EOD.
Logistics Ops: Booth kit: charger hub, HDMI dongles, easel for postcards, vinyl sticker wall. Table expected.
Priya Shah: Signage: finalize sticker-wall artwork and postcard stand mock by tonight. Upload proofs to drive and drop here.
Maya Li: Last minute: shipping budget cap is $350. If courier needed, confirm in this thread.
Owen Clark: Understood. I'll signal if courier required.
Maya Li: Thanks all. If no other flags I'll close actions at 5pm and confirm order. :rocket:
